process: Built-in image generator edited the inherited wall. Only new charcoal, chalk and ochre pigment in bare upper-left rock was transferred. Generated intermediate overwritten by the finished whole wall.

visual_review.status: locally inspected full PNG and 512-square JPEG
visual_review.pepe: Both inherited figures retain wide mouths and heavy-lidded eyes.
visual_review.hands: Both figures have concealed hands; no new hands, digits, prints or stencils.
visual_review.forbidden_elements: No letters, numbers, captions, logos, signatures, borders or forbidden symbols observed.
limitations: Fine worn pigment softens in the preview.
Local inspection is not independent visual approval.

preview_location_exception: The assignment explicitly requires the numbered JPEG beside its JSON in dist/line-1.
